The '''Queensguard''' were a military unit of [[Bodyguard/Legends|bodyguards]] that were charged with the protection of the [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] of the Royal House of [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]]. By the time of the [[Great Galactic War]], the royal family was [[House Panteer]] and the Queensguard were charged with the protection of their Queen.

==History==
During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], a fatally wounded [[Sir/Legends|Sir]] [[Deris Panteer]] of the Queensguard was in the search of the original [[Panteer crown|royal crown]] of Alderaan and found that it was in a container by the river where the [[Panteer Royal Transport]] crashed in the [[Glarus Valley]]. He tasked a traveler with the recovery of the crown from the wreckage and taking it to [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Lieber]] at the Panteer hideout.<ref name="The Head">{{TORcite|type=faction|Empire|The Head That Wears the Crown|[[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]]}}</ref>

[[Samara Organa]] attempted to discern the truth about the assassination of [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Gaul Panteer]] and uncover his murderer. She was allied with Captain [[Orrick Gwyndon]] of the Panteer Queensguard where they tasked a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] ally with recovering the assassination holorecording from the [[Library/Legends|library]] in the [[Holo Archives]] of [[Castle Panteer]].<ref name="Red Handed">{{TORcite|type=faction|Republic|Red Handed|[[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]]}}</ref>

The [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] attempted to bring about House Panteer's favor by eliminating [[Bouris Ulgo]] and aimed to reinstate the house. Lord [[Aurren Tuile Panteer]] dispatched an elite detachment of the Queensguard to accompany the Sith with the intention of arresting Bouris Ulgo. After the successfully completion of the task, a captain of the Queensguard resided in the throne room of Castle Panteer where he awaited the status of Bouris Ulgo.<ref name="Regicide">{{TORcite|type=faction|Empire|Regicide|[[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]]}}</ref>
